mapper.select: SELECT ID, RULE_SET_CODE, RULE_GROUP_CODE, MATCH_MODE, MIN_AMOUNT, MAX_AMOUNT, MIN_INCLUSIVE, MAX_INCLUSIVE, STEP_CODE, STEP_NAME, STEP_ORDER, STATUS, VERSION_NO, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM BUDGET_APPROVAL_RULE_CONFIG WHERE RULE_SET_CODE = #{ruleSetCode} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY CASE RULE_GROUP_CODE WHEN 'PROCEDURE_REQUIREMENT' THEN 1 WHEN 'AUTHORITY_LEVEL' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, STEP_ORDER
